name: local-ai-autocomplete
description: Inline code completions using local OpenAI-compatible models (Fill-in-the-Middle)

commands.title: Local AI Autocomplete: Refresh Model List
Local AI Autocomplete: Set API Key

localAiAutocomplete.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL (include /v1 if your server uses it).

localAiAutocomplete.model.description: Model ID for completions (exact id from your server, e.g. from GET /v1/models).

localAiAutocomplete.debounceMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after typing before requesting a completion.

localAiAutocomplete.prefixMaxChars.description: Maximum characters of prefix (before cursor) sent to the model.

localAiAutocomplete.suffixMaxChars.description: Maximum characters of suffix (after cursor) sent to the model.

enumDescriptions: POST /completions with prompt (prefix) only — use with vLLM and servers that reject suffix.
POST /completions with prompt (prefix) and suffix fields.
POST /completions with a single templated prompt (e.g. CodeLlama PRE/SUF/MID tokens).
Escape hatch: POST /chat/completions with fenced prefix/suffix — not true FiM; quality varies by model.
localAiAutocomplete.fimMode.description: How to encode Fill-in-the-Middle for the API.

localAiAutocomplete.fimTemplate.description: Prompt template when fimMode is template. Placeholders: {prefix}, {suffix}.

localAiAutocomplete.stop.description: Stop sequences for the completions API.

localAiAutocomplete.languages.description: Language IDs to enable (empty = all file documents).

localAiAutocomplete.debug.description: Log detailed information to the Local AI Autocomplete output channel.

localAiAutocomplete.includeRelatedContex.description: Include related workspace definitions (e.g. implemented types) in the model prompt. Disable to send only the active file.

localAiAutocomplete.relatedContextMaxCha.description: Maximum total characters from related workspace files per completion request.

localAiAutocomplete.relatedContextMaxFil.description: Maximum number of related files to attach per request.

enumDescriptions: Try language-server definitions first, then workspace file search.
Use only declaration heuristics and workspace file search (no LSP).
localAiAutocomplete.relatedContextStrate.description: How to resolve related types to workspace files.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node -r ./test/vscode-stub.cjs --test out-test/test/unit/**/*.test.js out-test/test/integration/*.test.js
